gloss: after a long time; for the first time in a while

definitions.gloss: after a long interval; for the first time in a while
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is happening for the first time after a long period. Most often used as {久々|ひさびさ}に (after a long time) or {久々|ひさびさ}の (long-awaited).

examples.japanese: {久々|ひさびさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met a friend for the first time in a while.

examples.japanese: {久々|ひさびさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{晴天|せいてん}→晴天：12972_seiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はかどった。
examples.english: With the first clear sky in a while, the laundry got done quickly.

examples.japanese: {久々|ひさびさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ったら→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずいぶん⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なっていた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I went back to my parents' home after a long time, the garden tree had grown quite a lot.

notes:
A casual word indicating that a long time has passed since something last happened. Nearly always used as {久々|ひさびさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial) or {久々|ひさびさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (modifier).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {久々|ひさびさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧: to meet after a long time
- {久々|ひさびさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧: a day off after a long while
- {久々|ひさびさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to return after a long absence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧: after a long time — very close in meaning and more common; {久々|ひさびさ} sounds slightly more casual and is used more often adverbially
- ⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: after a while — similar, with ⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧ (a while) as the time span
